title: Be a Multitude to Itself: A Prompt Evolution Framework for Red Teaming
findings: All tested language models demonstrated some level of vulnerability to generating harmful content when prompted about religion. According to the graphical data presented (Figure 4), the Attack Success Rate (ASR) for the topic of religion was in the mid-range compared to other sensitive topics, being notably lower than for 'fraud' but higher than for 'suicide'. The paper itself does not provide a detailed textual analysis of the 'religion' category results.
